external_candidates.operator_compatibility_failure: Original empty COALESCE and NULL binding failure retained; adapted fixed tool template passes execution and Jena equivalence; FedX duplicate rows retained

comparison_rule: Compare on the same supported deployment; no native versus RDF speedup; external API calls are not assumed one per case
sota_scope: Cite component evidence and benchmark scope; composition is not itself claimed to be an author-published SOTA system

scope_reporting.rule: Record capability, transport, model-format, timeout and answer quality separately. The adapted composition returned answers on both a single-source and a two-source tiny case; neither was correct. This does not establish arbitrary cross-source support or only-single-source capability.
scope_reporting.supported_runtime_failures: Keep in the corresponding stratum denominator
